headlineVerdict: Badass affirmation cards, Amazon US: a $0.45 cost per click (a one-year low) and a 50.7% gross margin at the category leader's $16.90 make this the only one of our four reviews whose unit economics hold. Identical boxed decks list at CNY 7.5 on 1688. Demand is down 40% year on year, so it is a short-cycle position. Verdict: worth testing before the holiday peak.
